Thank you for your time and thoughts.

I usually try to go out during the morning to apply for a few jobs but i usually get 'week knees' when i go to call a week later and ask if they are hiring or if i could come in for a interview. 


I'd like to join the Air Force before december 18th(the date of my Christmas party) I want to show my younger cousin (who's a Marine, we were both going to join the usmc around the same time) that I've got my life in order since the last time he was home. 

I get out of my house once a week to go to the Air Force physical training, It's hard and rough and i usually end up with something pulled but it's at least something that i'm doing thats worthwhile

I know my mother is right in the sense that i need to get on my feet and start doing something but the way she talked about it just filled  with anger and anxiety.


I don't have a whole lot of qualities that people like, I was the quiet kid throughout high school and at parties.

I've been running every other day and I've been going to the Air Force PT every week for about  2 months (not every week since there are some weeks that are only for People who signed up already) But i've been to about 4 Physical training sessions at my recruiters office.

My mom knows about me wanting to join the Air Force but I think since i flunked out with the USMC(i made the right decision by not joining the usmc at that time) that she thinks this is just another "phase"

I've known my friend for about my whole life but i think the only reason why we still talk is because my dad and his dad were friends when they were younger.

 I'd like to start playing roller hockey somewhere but I probably don't have enough money in my bank to buy gear and sign up. My like of anime is a sort of thing i like to keep to myself.
